model_notes: Interstate twin: the WB structure (BWBL) sits ~30 ft to the north and is modelled as a mirrored twin.

Slab edge is a deep stepped coping with the parapet on top (photos 17-18); piers are solid concrete walls 46.5 ft long with rounded ends, the slab bearing directly on them (photos 26-28, 31; element list 'pier wall 46.5').
Abutments are low concrete caps on a spill-through embankment with short wingwalls (photos 19-20, 28); grass channel with a small ditch, cornfields either side (photos 29-31).
Heavy longitudinal tining on the 1995 overlay, wide cracks and patches (photos 12-15).
